description: EVENT screen: names that CROSSED a line on a recent settled close (RSI 30/70, EMA 9/20, SMA 50/150, divergence, candles, volume), plus provisional ones crossing today. Answers "what changed?"; get_rsi_watch "what's stretched". Analyst plan.

family.description: Keep only rows where a kind of this family fired inside the window — a coarser filter than `signal`.

include_history.description: Include each row's ~40-point 100-session [unix_seconds, close, sma50, sma150] series (the provisional rows' too). Default false.

include_notes.description: Include the static `thresholds` + `signalKinds` catalogue (~2.5k tokens, byte-identical on every response). Default false — the row-level `kind` ids are self-describing, and describe_dataset('get_breakout_moves') carries the same catalogue. Ask for it once if you want the labels and thresholds verbatim.

lane.description: Keep rows carrying a signal in this direction. 'both' (default) = every row; 'up' = names that reclaimed / crossed up / reversed up; 'down' = names that lost / crossed down / reversed down. A row with both kinds appears in either lane.

min_confluence.description: Fewest distinct kinds a row must carry inside the window. Default 1 (every row); 2 keeps only names where signals stack.

min_market_cap.description: Minimum market cap in USD dollars. Default 1e10 ($10B, the dashboard default); the universe floor is 2e9 ($2B) and smaller values clamp to it.

sector.description: Keep only one sector (the screener's own taxonomy, not GICS — see the description). 'other' = names no sector lookup returned.

signal.description: Keep only rows where this kind fired inside the window. Ids as in the payload's signalKinds catalogue.

top.description: Most rows to return after the filters, in the served order (confluence-descending). Default 30 — about 7k tokens with the envelope; 50 crosses the 10k client warning. The cut is recorded in `truncated`. When `top_per_sector` is set and this is omitted, the default steps aside so the per-sector board is not clipped.

top_per_sector.description: Keep at most N rows per sector, applied BEFORE `top`. Rows rank confluence-descending GLOBALLY, so a flat `top` starves the thin sectors — top_per_sector=3 is how you get 'the top 3 in every sector' in ONE call instead of one call per sector. Setting it also drops `top`'s default 30 (an explicit `top` still applies). The cut is recorded in `perSectorTruncated`; `sectors` still reports each sector's full depth.

top_provisional.description: Most `provisional` rows (names whose ONLY event is a cross today's unsettled bar would make — provisional, not signals) to return, in stored order (most pending row-making kinds, then cap). Default 10 — about 2k tokens; `top` and `top_per_sector` never cut this list. 0 omits it. The cut is recorded in `provisionalTruncated`.

window.description: Sessions back a cross may sit: 1 (default) = the last settled close only; 5 = the whole stored week. Signals older than the window are dropped and confluence recomputed.

name: get_breakout_moves
